newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on technical correction.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on technical correction.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Thursday on a technical correction after the index fell in five previous trading sessions, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index ended 0.47 points, or 0.03 percent, up at 1,413.59 amid 168 losers and 82 gainers. Volume fell to 32 million shares from Wednesday's 36 million.
"Finally, a technical correction materialised today, but it has not as much potential as expected," a dealer at Ali Husain Rajabali said.
The index gained 6.23 points in early trade, but overall sentiment remained mixed, the dealer said.
Short-term investors off-loaded stocks to square their positions before the Friday-Saturday weekend, he said.
PSO rose 6.00 rupees to 368, HUBCO 0.15 to 33.50, PTCL 0.05 to 27.05 and Fauji Fertiliser 0.35 to 67.85. Parke-Davis fell 5.00 to 565 and Siemens Engineering 4.00 to 169.
